subject: [Example] rmarkdown v2 chunk line numbering hook.

messages.author: 1b500d81402bb586
messages.subject: [Example] rmarkdown v2 chunk line numbering hook.
parts:
A little hook making use of the pandoc `numberLines` class allowing

```{r, eval=FALSE, number=TRUE}
# start code
# --->8---
# end code
```

Looks pretty good.

http://rpubs.com/Thell/numberLines

Looks interesting. So the basic idea is to use ```{.r .number
[startFrom]} instead of ```r. I guess I can support it in knitr. Pull
requests are welcome! :)
